rv.q: Here is true magic: people, of all ages and conditions, collectively re-imagining reality.
Playwright Nick Lane, freely adapting the version by Hanna Diyab, is attuned to the coming-of-age shape of the tale.

cn.t: A magical, cheerful production that delivers seasonal pantomime fun with a hardworking cast. The age-old story enchants audiences young and old, successfully suspending disbelief through brisk storytelling and song.
